integrity: Full mathematical proof and standalone finite checker are included. Extent of literature comparison and priority uncertainties are disclosed; independent mathematical and priority audits have not been performed.
limitations: Exact classification is for finite labelled three-level ordinal sums of nonempty antichains and equivalence accessibility satisfying precisely two specified confluence conditions. It does not count valuations or all modal models; no additional frame constraints are imposed.
title: Rigidity and exact Bell-number census of three-level S5-confluent frames
